title: Proficient
description: Understand virtually everything, summarise and rebuild arguments from different sources, and express yourself spontaneously and precisely, with fine shades of meaning.

id.title: Sangat Mahir
id.description: Memahami hampir semua yang didengar dan dibaca, meringkas dan merekonstruksi argumen dari berbagai sumber, serta berekspresi spontan dan presisi termasuk nuansa makna yang halus.

nodes.title: Grammar for Style
nodes.summary: Choose structures such as inversion, cleft sentences and fronting to control focus, emphasis and rhythm in real texts.
nodes.canDo: Can choose and vary sentence structures deliberately to control focus, emphasis and rhythm.

objectives.text: Choose structures that put the focus and rhythm where you want them
Vary sentence length and structure to avoid monotony
Use inversion, cleft sentences and fronting naturally in real contexts

commonErrors.wrong: Never I have seen such a mess.
commonErrors.right: Never have I seen such a mess.

commonErrors.wrong: Only when I read the report I understood the problem.
commonErrors.right: Only when I read the report did I understand the problem.

commonErrors.wrong: What I need it is more time.
commonErrors.right: What I need is more time.

id.title: Grammar untuk Gaya Bahasa
id.summary: Memilih struktur seperti inversion, cleft sentence dan fronting untuk mengatur fokus, penekanan dan ritme dalam teks nyata.
id.canDo: Bisa memilih dan memvariasikan struktur kalimat dengan sengaja untuk mengatur fokus, penekanan dan ritme.

objectives.choose-for-focus: Memilih struktur kalimat yang menempatkan fokus dan ritme sesuai tujuan
objectives.vary-sentences: Memvariasikan panjang dan struktur kalimat agar tidak monoton
objectives.inversion-cleft-fronting: Memakai inversion, cleft sentence dan fronting secara alami dalam konteks nyata

nodes.title: Complex Sentence Control
nodes.summary: Write multi-clause sentences with parallel structure and long noun phrases that stay clear and unambiguous.
nodes.canDo: Can build long, complex sentences that stay clear, balanced and free of ambiguity.

objectives.text: Build multi-clause sentences with correct parallel structure
Write long noun phrases that are still easy to follow
Spot and fix ambiguity such as dangling modifiers and unclear references

commonErrors.wrong: The project aims to reduce costs, improving quality and to train staff.
commonErrors.right: The project aims to reduce costs, improve quality and train staff.

commonErrors.wrong: Walking into the office, the computer was already on.
commonErrors.right: Walking into the office, I saw that the computer was already on.

commonErrors.wrong: the government new rural school teacher training funding policy
commonErrors.right: the government's new policy on funding teacher training in rural schools

id.title: Penguasaan Kalimat Kompleks
id.summary: Menulis kalimat bertingkat dengan struktur paralel dan noun phrase panjang yang tetap jelas dan tidak ambigu.
id.canDo: Bisa menyusun kalimat panjang dan kompleks yang tetap jelas, seimbang dan tidak ambigu.

objectives.multi-clause-parallelism: Menyusun kalimat bertingkat dengan struktur paralel yang benar
objectives.clear-noun-phrases: Menulis noun phrase panjang yang tetap mudah dipahami
objectives.avoid-ambiguity: Menemukan dan memperbaiki ambiguitas, seperti dangling modifier dan rujukan yang tidak jelas

nodes.title: Idiomatic Mastery
nodes.summary: Idioms, fixed expressions and natural phrasing, including how speakers vary and play with them.
nodes.canDo: Can use idiomatic expressions accurately and naturally, and recognise when they are varied or played with.

objectives.text: Use idiomatic expressions accurately and naturally
Recognise and use variations and playful twists on idioms

commonErrors.wrong: It's not my cup of coffee.
commonErrors.right: It's not my cup of tea.

commonErrors.wrong: We killed two birds with one rock.
commonErrors.right: We killed two birds with one stone.

commonErrors.wrong: The board thought the quarterly results were a piece of cake. (formal report)
commonErrors.right: The board found the quarterly results straightforward.

id.title: Penguasaan Idiom
id.summary: Idiom, ungkapan baku dan frasa yang alami, termasuk cara penutur memvariasikan dan memainkannya.
id.canDo: Bisa memakai ungkapan idiomatis dengan tepat dan alami, serta mengenali saat idiom divariasikan atau dimainkan.

objectives.use-idiomatic-expressions: Menggunakan ungkapan idiomatis dengan tepat dan alami
objectives.idiom-variation-play: Mengenali dan memakai variasi serta permainan idiom

nodes.title: Colloquial Language & Slang
nodes.summary: Understand informal spoken English and slang, use them with care, and know key UK/US vocabulary differences.
nodes.canDo: Can understand colloquial language and slang and use informal vocabulary appropriately for the situation.

objectives.text: Understand and use informal spoken English (e.g. gonna, kind of, reckon)
Understand common slang and judge when it is safe to use it
Recognise common UK/US vocabulary differences (e.g. flat/apartment, holiday/vacation)

commonErrors.wrong: I gonna call you later.
commonErrors.right: I'm gonna call you later. (speech) / I'm going to call you later.

commonErrors.wrong: Dear Sir or Madam, I wanna ask about the job.
commonErrors.right: Dear Sir or Madam, I would like to ask about the job.

commonErrors.wrong: "I like your pants." meaning trousers, in the UK
commonErrors.right: "I like your trousers." (in British English, pants are underwear)

id.title: Bahasa Kolokial & Slang
id.summary: Memahami bahasa lisan informal dan slang, memakainya dengan hati-hati, dan mengenal perbedaan kosakata UK/US.
id.canDo: Bisa memahami bahasa kolokial dan slang serta memakai kosakata informal sesuai situasi.

objectives.informal-spoken: Memahami dan memakai bahasa lisan informal (mis. gonna, kind of, reckon)
objectives.slang-with-care: Memahami slang yang umum dan menilai kapan aman memakainya
objectives.uk-us-vocabulary: Mengenali perbedaan kosakata UK/US yang umum (mis. flat/apartment, holiday/vacation)

nodes.title: Figurative Language & Wordplay
nodes.summary: Metaphor, figurative language, humour, puns and cultural references in English.
nodes.canDo: Can understand and use metaphor, wordplay and cultural references, and appreciate the humour they create.

objectives.text: Understand and use metaphor and other figurative language
Recognise humour and wordplay such as puns and double meanings
Understand common cultural references and allusions

commonErrors.wrong: He is long-handed. (from "panjang tangan")
commonErrors.right: He is light-fingered. / He steals things.

commonErrors.wrong: He's a land crocodile. (from "buaya darat")
commonErrors.right: He's a player. / He's a womaniser.

commonErrors.wrong: We need to nip it in the bud before it snowballs out of the water.
commonErrors.right: We need to nip it in the bud before it snowballs.

id.title: Bahasa Kiasan & Permainan Kata
id.summary: Metafora, bahasa kiasan, humor, permainan kata dan referensi budaya dalam bahasa Inggris.
id.canDo: Bisa memahami dan memakai metafora, permainan kata dan referensi budaya, serta menangkap humornya.

objectives.metaphor-figurative: Memahami dan memakai metafora serta bahasa kiasan lainnya
objectives.humour-wordplay: Mengenali humor dan permainan kata seperti pun dan makna ganda
objectives.cultural-references: Memahami referensi dan kiasan budaya yang umum

nodes.title: Implied Meaning
nodes.summary: Irony, understatement and subtext: understanding and conveying what people mean but don't say.
nodes.canDo: Can interpret irony, understatement and subtext, and convey meaning indirectly when it suits the situation.

objectives.text: Interpret and convey implied meaning
Recognise irony and understatement and what the speaker really means
Follow the subtext of a conversation: what is meant but not said

commonErrors.wrong: Taking "I'm not sure that's the best idea" as real uncertainty
commonErrors.right: It is often a polite way of saying "I disagree"

id.title: Makna Tersirat
id.summary: Ironi, understatement dan subteks: memahami dan menyampaikan maksud yang tidak diucapkan langsung.
id.canDo: Bisa menafsirkan ironi, understatement dan subteks, serta menyampaikan maksud secara tidak langsung bila situasinya cocok.

objectives.irony-understatement: Mengenali ironi dan understatement serta maksud sebenarnya dari pembicara
objectives.conversation-subtext: Menangkap subteks dalam percakapan: apa yang dimaksud tetapi tidak diucapkan

nodes.title: Natural Prosody & Nuance
nodes.summary: Use intonation and stress to convey sarcasm, doubt and subtle attitudes, and adapt your delivery to the audience.
nodes.canDo: Can vary intonation and stress to express subtle attitudes such as sarcasm or doubt, and adapt delivery to the audience.

objectives.text: Convey sarcasm, doubt and subtle attitudes through intonation
Recognise a speaker's attitude from their intonation and stress
Adjust pace, volume and speaking style to suit the audience

commonErrors.wrong: Saying "Great." with the same flat tone for praise and for sarcasm
commonErrors.right: Lively rise-fall for real praise; flat, low or drawn-out "Gre-eat" for sarcasm

commonErrors.wrong: Equal stress on every word: "I DIDN'T SAY SHE TOOK IT"
commonErrors.right: Stress the word that carries the contrast: "I didn't say SHE took it" (someone else did)

commonErrors.wrong: A falling tone on a doubtful statement, so it sounds certain
commonErrors.right: A fall-rise to show doubt or reservation: "It MIGHT work..."

id.title: Prosodi Alami & Nuansa
id.summary: Memakai intonasi dan tekanan kata untuk menyampaikan sarkasme, keraguan dan sikap halus, serta menyesuaikan gaya bicara dengan audiens.
id.canDo: Bisa mengatur intonasi dan tekanan kata untuk menunjukkan sikap halus seperti sarkasme atau keraguan, dan menyesuaikan cara bicara dengan audiens.

objectives.attitude-intonation: Menyampaikan sarkasme, keraguan dan sikap halus lewat intonasi
objectives.hear-attitude: Mengenali sikap pembicara dari intonasi dan tekanan katanya
objectives.adapt-to-audience: Menyesuaikan tempo, volume dan gaya bicara dengan audiens

nodes.title: Listening to Fast, Natural Speech
nodes.summary: Follow fast, colloquial speech, overlapping conversations, films and comedy.
nodes.canDo: Can follow fast, colloquial speech and overlapping conversations, and understand films and much of their humour.

objectives.text: Follow fast, colloquial speech with reduced forms and slang
Follow conversations where speakers interrupt and talk over each other
Understand films, TV series and stand-up comedy, including most of the jokes

id.title: Menyimak Ucapan Cepat & Alami
id.summary: Memahami ucapan cepat dan kolokial, percakapan yang tumpang tindih, film dan komedi.
id.canDo: Bisa mengikuti ucapan cepat dan kolokial serta percakapan yang tumpang tindih, dan memahami film beserta sebagian besar humornya.

objectives.fast-colloquial: Memahami ucapan cepat dan kolokial yang penuh bentuk ringkas dan slang
objectives.overlapping-talk: Mengikuti percakapan saat pembicara saling memotong dan bicara tumpang tindih
objectives.film-comedy: Memahami film, serial TV dan stand-up comedy, termasuk sebagian besar leluconnya

nodes.title: Literary & Abstract Texts
nodes.summary: Read literature, philosophical essays and ironic opinion columns, and interpret the writer's style.
nodes.canDo: Can read literary and abstract texts and interpret the author's style, tone and implied stance.

objectives.text: Understand literary texts and philosophical essays
Interpret ironic or satirical opinion columns
Explain how a writer's style creates meaning and tone

id.title: Teks Sastra & Abstrak
id.summary: Membaca karya sastra, esai filosofis dan kolom opini yang ironis, serta menafsirkan gaya penulisnya.
id.canDo: Bisa membaca teks sastra dan abstrak serta menafsirkan gaya, nada dan sikap tersirat penulisnya.

objectives.literature-essays: Memahami teks sastra dan esai filosofis
objectives.ironic-columns: Menafsirkan kolom opini yang ironis atau satir
objectives.author-style: Menjelaskan bagaimana gaya penulis membangun makna dan nada

nodes.title: Rhetoric & Persuasion
nodes.summary: Structure, emphasis and rhetorical devices for persuasive writing.
nodes.canDo: Can use rhetorical devices and a clear structure to build a persuasive case in writing.

objectives.text: Use rhetorical devices for effect
Build a persuasive case

id.title: Retorika & Persuasi
id.summary: Struktur, penekanan dan gaya bahasa retoris untuk tulisan yang persuasif.
id.canDo: Bisa memakai gaya bahasa retoris dan struktur yang jelas untuk membangun argumen tertulis yang persuasif.

objectives.use-rhetorical-devices: Menggunakan gaya bahasa retoris untuk efek tertentu

nodes.title: Precision & Reformulation
nodes.summary: Express fine shades of meaning, rephrase smoothly when you get stuck, and emphasise or soften points precisely.
nodes.canDo: Can express fine shades of meaning precisely and reformulate so smoothly that listeners hardly notice.

objectives.text: Express fine shades of meaning (e.g. concerned vs alarmed, likely vs bound to)
Reformulate smoothly when you get stuck for a word or idea
Emphasise or soften a point precisely (e.g. utterly, somewhat, arguably)

commonErrors.wrong: Going silent or switching to Indonesian when a word is missing
commonErrors.right: Paraphrase and keep going: "What I mean is..." / "It's the kind of thing that..."

id.title: Presisi & Reformulasi
id.summary: Mengekspresikan nuansa makna yang halus, merumuskan ulang dengan mulus saat buntu, serta menekankan atau melunakkan secara presisi.
id.canDo: Bisa mengungkapkan nuansa makna dengan presisi dan merumuskan ulang dengan begitu mulus sehingga pendengar hampir tidak menyadarinya.

objectives.fine-nuance: Mengekspresikan nuansa makna yang halus (mis. concerned vs alarmed, likely vs bound to)
objectives.reformulate-smoothly: Merumuskan ulang dengan mulus saat buntu mencari kata atau ide
objectives.emphasise-soften: Menekankan atau melunakkan pendapat secara presisi (mis. utterly, somewhat, arguably)

nodes.title: Public Speaking
nodes.summary: Deliver keynote-style talks using spoken rhetorical devices, and adapt as you read the audience's reactions.
nodes.canDo: Can deliver a well-structured keynote-style talk with confident rhetoric and adapt it to the audience's reactions.

objectives.text: Deliver a well-structured, keynote-style talk
Use spoken rhetorical devices such as the rule of three, pauses and rhetorical questions
Adapt content and delivery to the audience's reactions

id.title: Berbicara di Depan Umum
id.summary: Menyampaikan pidato setara keynote dengan gaya retoris lisan, dan menyesuaikan diri dengan reaksi audiens.
id.canDo: Bisa menyampaikan pidato setara keynote yang terstruktur dengan retorika yang meyakinkan, dan menyesuaikannya dengan reaksi audiens.

objectives.keynote-talk: Menyampaikan pidato setara keynote yang terstruktur dengan baik
objectives.spoken-rhetoric: Memakai gaya retoris lisan seperti rule of three, jeda dan pertanyaan retoris
objectives.read-the-room: Menyesuaikan isi dan cara penyampaian dengan reaksi audiens

nodes.title: Critical Reviews
nodes.summary: Evaluate books, studies, films or ideas in a balanced, well-supported written review.
nodes.canDo: Can write a balanced critical review that weighs strengths and weaknesses and reaches a justified conclusion.

objectives.text: Write a balanced critical review
Evaluate strengths and weaknesses with supporting evidence
Reach a clear, justified overall judgement

id.title: Ulasan Kritis
id.summary: Mengevaluasi buku, penelitian, film atau gagasan dalam ulasan tertulis yang berimbang dan didukung bukti.
id.canDo: Bisa menulis ulasan kritis yang berimbang, menimbang kelebihan dan kekurangan, dan sampai pada kesimpulan yang beralasan.

objectives.evaluate-with-evidence: Menilai kelebihan dan kekurangan dengan bukti pendukung
objectives.justified-verdict: Menyimpulkan penilaian akhir yang jelas dan beralasan

nodes.title: Stylistic Nuance
nodes.summary: Precision, rhythm and voice: adjusting style and tone to the reader and purpose.
nodes.canDo: Can adjust style and tone precisely and keep a consistent voice suited to the reader and purpose.

objectives.text: Adjust style and tone with precision
Control rhythm and word choice to keep a consistent voice
Rewrite the same message for different readers and purposes

id.title: Nuansa Gaya
id.summary: Ketepatan, ritme dan suara tulisan: menyesuaikan gaya dan nada dengan pembaca dan tujuan.
id.canDo: Bisa menyesuaikan gaya dan nada dengan tepat dan menjaga suara tulisan yang konsisten sesuai pembaca dan tujuannya.

objectives.adjust-style-and: Menyesuaikan gaya dan nada dengan tepat
objectives.rhythm-word-choice: Mengatur ritme dan pilihan kata agar suara tulisan tetap konsisten
objectives.rewrite-for-reader: Menulis ulang pesan yang sama untuk pembaca dan tujuan yang berbeda

nodes.title: Creative Writing & Voice
nodes.summary: Write narrative and description in your own voice, with natural dialogue and the show, don't tell technique.
nodes.canDo: Can write engaging stories and descriptions in a distinctive voice, with natural dialogue.

objectives.text: Write narrative and description in a distinctive voice
Write dialogue that sounds natural
Use show, don't tell to reveal feelings and character

commonErrors.wrong: She was very sad.
commonErrors.right: She stared at the unopened letter until her tea went cold.

id.title: Menulis Kreatif & Suara Penulis
id.summary: Menulis narasi dan deskripsi dengan suara khasmu, dialog yang alami, dan teknik show, don't tell.
id.canDo: Bisa menulis cerita dan deskripsi yang menarik dengan suara yang khas dan dialog yang alami.

objectives.distinctive-voice: Menulis narasi dan deskripsi dengan suara yang khas
objectives.show-dont-tell: Memakai teknik show, don't tell untuk menampilkan perasaan dan karakter

nodes.title: Editing & Proofreading
nodes.summary: Edit for concision and consistency, follow a style guide, and give useful feedback on other people's writing.
nodes.canDo: Can edit and proofread texts for concision, consistency and style, and give constructive feedback to other writers.

objectives.text: Edit texts so they are concise and consistent
Follow a style guide for spelling, punctuation, terminology and formatting
Give clear, constructive feedback on other people's writing

commonErrors.wrong: In order to be able to make a decision regarding the budget, we need more data.
commonErrors.right: To decide on the budget, we need more data.

id.title: Menyunting & Proofreading
id.summary: Menyunting agar ringkas dan konsisten, mengikuti style guide, dan memberi feedback yang berguna pada tulisan orang lain.
id.canDo: Bisa menyunting dan memeriksa teks agar ringkas, konsisten dan sesuai gaya, serta memberi feedback yang membangun.

objectives.concise-consistent: Menyunting teks agar ringkas dan konsisten
objectives.style-guide: Mengikuti style guide untuk ejaan, tanda baca, istilah dan format
objectives.give-feedback: Memberi feedback yang jelas dan membangun pada tulisan orang lain

nodes.title: Summarising & Reconstructing Arguments
nodes.summary: Summarise several complex sources, reconstruct their arguments coherently and write a concise précis.
nodes.canDo: Can summarise information from several complex sources, reconstructing their arguments in a coherent whole.

objectives.text: Summarise several complex sources in one coherent text
Reconstruct each source's argument accurately and coherently
Write a précis: a short, accurate summary in your own words

id.title: Meringkas & Merekonstruksi Argumen
id.summary: Meringkas banyak sumber kompleks, merekonstruksi argumennya secara koheren, dan menulis précis yang padat.
id.canDo: Bisa meringkas informasi dari banyak sumber kompleks dan merekonstruksi argumennya menjadi satu kesatuan yang koheren.

objectives.summarise-sources: Meringkas banyak sumber kompleks dalam satu teks yang koheren
objectives.reconstruct-arguments: Merekonstruksi argumen tiap sumber secara akurat dan koheren
objectives.write-precis: Menulis précis: ringkasan pendek dan akurat dengan kata-kata sendiri

nodes.title: High-Stakes Communication
nodes.summary: Deliver bad news, communicate in a crisis and disagree diplomatically with managers or clients.
nodes.canDo: Can handle sensitive, high-stakes conversations, such as giving bad news or disagreeing with a senior person, clearly and diplomatically.

objectives.text: Deliver bad news clearly and with empathy
Communicate clearly in a crisis: what happened, what you are doing, what comes next
Disagree diplomatically with a manager or client

commonErrors.wrong: Maybe there is a little problem with the deadline, but it's okay.
commonErrors.right: I'm afraid we won't meet the 15 March deadline. Here's what we can do instead.

id.title: Komunikasi Berisiko Tinggi
id.summary: Menyampaikan kabar buruk, berkomunikasi saat krisis, dan tidak setuju secara diplomatis dengan atasan atau klien.
id.canDo: Bisa menangani percakapan sensitif yang berisiko tinggi, seperti menyampaikan kabar buruk atau tidak setuju dengan atasan, secara jelas dan diplomatis.

objectives.deliver-bad-news: Menyampaikan kabar buruk dengan jelas dan empatik
objectives.crisis-communication: Berkomunikasi dengan jelas saat krisis: apa yang terjadi, apa yang sedang dilakukan, dan langkah selanjutnya
objectives.disagree-diplomatically: Menyatakan ketidaksetujuan secara diplomatis kepada atasan atau klien

nodes.title: Cross-Cultural Mediation
nodes.summary: Explain cultural norms, handle direct and indirect politeness, and help people from different cultures understand each other.
nodes.canDo: Can mediate between people from different cultures, explaining norms and clarifying what each side really means.

objectives.text: Explain cultural norms and expectations to people from another culture
Compare direct and indirect politeness strategies and choose the right one
Bridge misunderstandings by clarifying what each side means

commonErrors.wrong: Translating a polite "iya, nanti kami pertimbangkan" as a firm yes
commonErrors.right: Explain that it may be a soft no, and check what the speaker really means

id.title: Mediasi Lintas Budaya
id.summary: Menjelaskan norma budaya, memahami kesopanan langsung dan tidak langsung, serta membantu orang dari budaya berbeda saling memahami.
id.canDo: Bisa menjadi penengah antara orang dari budaya berbeda, menjelaskan norma dan memperjelas maksud sebenarnya dari tiap pihak.

objectives.explain-norms: Menjelaskan norma dan harapan budaya kepada orang dari budaya lain
objectives.politeness-strategies: Membandingkan strategi kesopanan langsung dan tidak langsung, lalu memilih yang tepat
objectives.bridge-meaning: Menjembatani salah paham dengan memperjelas maksud tiap pihak

nodes.title: C2 Checkpoint
nodes.summary: Mixed test of all C2 strands (format similar to C2 Proficiency / IELTS 8.5+). Pass: 70+ in every strand, 80+ overall.
nodes.canDo: Can show C2-level proficiency across grammar, vocabulary, listening, reading, speaking, writing and mediation.

objectives.text: Complete a mixed test of every C2 strand, in a format similar to C2 Proficiency / IELTS 8.5+
Use C2 grammar and vocabulary accurately and flexibly
Understand implied meaning in demanding texts and recordings
Speak, write and mediate at length with precision and nuance

id.title: Checkpoint C2
id.summary: Tes campuran semua strand C2 (format mirip C2 Proficiency / IELTS 8.5+). Lulus: minimal 70 di tiap strand dan rata-rata 80.
id.canDo: Bisa menunjukkan kemampuan setara C2 di grammar, kosakata, listening, reading, speaking, writing dan mediasi.

objectives.all-strands: Menyelesaikan tes campuran semua strand C2 dengan format mirip C2 Proficiency / IELTS 8.5+
objectives.language-precision: Memakai grammar dan kosakata C2 dengan akurat dan luwes
objectives.implicit-meaning: Memahami makna tersirat dalam teks dan rekaman yang menantang
objectives.productive-tasks: Berbicara, menulis dan melakukan mediasi secara panjang dengan presisi dan nuansa
